title: 第35章 符成
content_zh:
第35章 符成-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

等到房间里彻底安静下来，吴姜才松了一口气，坐在书桌前，闭上眼睛，在脑海里仔细回忆画符的要点——心要静、气要稳、手要准，一笔呵成，不能有丝毫停顿，还要注入一丝自身的气息，否则符纸就是一张废纸。

他深吸一口气，缓缓睁开眼睛，将朱砂倒在砚台里化开，随后拿起毛笔，蘸上朱砂，再次闭上眼睛，集中全部精神。

几秒钟后，他猛地睁开眼睛，手腕微动，毛笔稳稳地落在了黄纸上，快速勾勒起来。

一气呵成，没有丝毫停顿，一张废符就出炉了。

他黑着脸，把废符揉成一团，扔在一边，没有气馁，而是总结经验。

刚才太紧张了，心不够静，手也不够稳。

重新下笔，于是，第二张废符又诞生了。

吴姜此刻无比庆幸，将人都赶了出去，这才没有影响他英明神武的形象。

一连十几张符纸画下来，终于，一道带有微薄法力波动的符纸诞生了。

“太好了！终于成功了！”忍不住在心里欢呼一声，脸上露出了得意的笑容。

吴姜顾不上擦拭额头上的汗水，赶紧拿起桌上的符纸，仔细欣赏起来。

通体都是让人看不懂的线条，但是上面流转的波动，让吴姜欣喜若狂。

自己果然是画符的天才，这么快就画出了自己人生中的第一张符箓。

再接再厉，有了第一次成功的经验，这次很快，又重新画了两张新的出来。

吴姜满意地看着桌上的三张符纸，随后才打开房门，走了出去。

他刚一开门，三道齐刷刷的目光，就立刻投向了他。

吴姜将“阴阳通目符”一一给了他们三个，示意他们将符纸粘在衣服上。

When the room was completely quiet, Wu Jiang breathed a sigh of relief. He sat at the desk, closed his eyes, and carefully recalled in his mind the key points of drawing talisman - the mind must be calm, the breath must be steady, and the hand must be accurate. It must be done in one stroke without any pause, and a trace of his own breath must be injected, otherwise the talisman paper will be a piece of waste paper.

He took a deep breath, slowly opened his eyes, poured cinnabar into the inkstone to dissolve, then picked up the brush, dipped it in cinnabar, closed his eyes again, and concentrated all his energy.

A few seconds later, he opened his eyes suddenly, moved his wrist slightly, and landed the brush firmly on the yellow paper, quickly sketching.

Completed in one go, without any pause, a useless talisman was released.

With a dark face, he crumpled the waste talisman into a ball and threw it aside. He was not discouraged, but summed up his experience.

I was too nervous just now, my mind was not calm enough, and my hands were not steady enough.

I started writing again, and the second waste talisman was born.

Wu Jiang was extremely lucky at this moment. He drove everyone out, so that his image of being wise and powerful was not affected.

After drawing more than a dozen talisman papers in succession, finally, a talisman paper with a slight fluctuation of mana was born.

"Great! It finally worked!" I couldn't help but cheer in my heart, with a proud smile on my face.

Wu Jiang didn't bother to wipe the sweat from his forehead, and quickly picked up the talisman on the table and admired it carefully.

The whole body was filled with lines that were incomprehensible, but the fluctuations flowing on them made Wu Jiang ecstatic.

He is indeed a genius at drawing talismans, and he drew the first talisman in his life so quickly.

I kept working hard and had the first successful experience. This time I quickly drew two new ones.

Wu Jiang looked at the three talismans on the table with satisfaction, then opened the door and walked out.

As soon as he opened the door, three eyes immediately turned to him.

Wu Jiang gave the "Yin-Yang Eye-Opening Talisman" to the three of them one by one, and told them to stick the talisman paper on their clothes.
